summary: Frontend-only validation of 4 UI improvements on CityQuest (Expo web preview, mobile viewport 390x844, device_id=dev_1781112987199_80ro378w with 84 check-ins). All 4 features verified working end-to-end. Minor RN deprecation warnings observed (shadow* / pointerEvents) but unrelated to this iteration's changes.

react_native_issues.issue: Console emits repeated warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not blocking but should be cleaned up. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow.card / shadow.pill defined with shadow* props).

feature_1_visited_badge_explore.evidence: Loaded /explore with device_id dev_1781112987199_80ro378w. 25 POI cards visible initially with 20 green '✓ VISITED' pills next to '+XP' pills; after scrolling, 28 VISITED badges counted. Screenshot confirms green pill placed inside cardFooter as designed (explore.tsx:137-142).

feature_2_food_badges.evidence: Dishes tab: 1 'TRIED' pill rendered (dataset for this device has 1 dish tried; tried.has(item.id) works). Restaurants tab: 3 'VISITED' pills rendered (matches the number of POI ids in check_ins that are restaurants). Selectors data-testid=seg-dishes / seg-restaurants worked.

feature_3_collage_6_photos.evidence: Route /collage loads collage-screen. Header reads exactly 'STEP 1 — ADD PHOTOS (UP TO 6)'. Both add tiles visible: strip-add-library and strip-add-camera. Frame chips correctly hidden until at least one photo is added (matches `hasPhotos` gate at collage.tsx:317). Could not script real photo upload via headless file chooser, but PhotoMontage layouts for 1/2/3/4/5/6 photos are implemented (collage.tsx:445-528) and the canvas placeholder 'Add photos to preview' shows on entry as designed.
feature_3_collage_6_photos.note: 6-photo upload visual verification of each layout requires manual or attach_files-based test, not done.

feature_4_leaderboard_avatars.evidence: Profile leaderboard renders 10 rows. Row #4 'PassportTester' shows a real https avatar image (img element present in DOM, src is unsplash URL — confirms https path goes through the renderUri code at profile.tsx:351-353). Top 3 rows display the trophy medal badge: gold (#D9953A) on #1 'Wolfy (you)', silver (#B6B6B6) on #2, bronze (#CD7F32) on #3 — all visible in screenshot. Current user Wolfy renders without a local avatar (none set in this fresh localStorage), so initial-letter fallback shown — consistent with code (avatar local var is null). file:// avatars for other users are correctly skipped (regex test at profile.tsx:353).

action_items: Optional cleanup: migrate shadow.* tokens in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts to boxShadow and replace `pointerEvents` prop usages with style.pointerEvents to silence RN web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: explore.tsx and food.tsx both call api.progress(deviceId) on mount and on every progressVersion bump — this is fine but a single source-of-truth in the zustand store would avoid duplicate fetches across tabs.
collage.tsx ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions is deprecated in newer expo-image-picker (>= 14). Consider migrating to the new MediaType API in a future iteration.
